title: Blue Bug Embodied Releases Modular Humanoid Robot Xiao Bai, Starting at 0.98 Ten Thousand Yuan
excerpt: The technology transfer enterprise of Xi'an Jiaotong University, Lan Chong, officially launched the new modular humanoid robot Mantis Standard "Bai Xiao" on Sep
content_html:
The technology transfer enterprise of Xi'an Jiaotong University, Lan Chong, officially launched the new modular humanoid robot Mantis Standard "Bai Xiao" on September 14. This product breaks the high threshold of traditional humanoid robots, with a starting price of only 0.98 million yuan, attracting widespread attention in the industry.

Official positioning shows that "Bai Xiao" is not only a conventional humanoid robot but also a body-intelligent platform that can flexibly transform into various forms. In terms of hardware structure, its chassis, arms, waist, and head all adopt standard module design, and the modules are connected through quick-fit interfaces for mechanical and electrical connections, greatly enhancing the system's scalability and playability.

In terms of specific parameters, "Bai Xiao" has a total height of 1.4 meters, 22 degrees of freedom throughout the body, a single arm load capacity of 7kg, an arm span of 663mm, and a remote operation delay of less than 10ms. In addition, its waist has a lifting range of 550mm, the chassis supports 3-degree-of-freedom omnidirectional movement, with a forward speed of up to 3m/s, a lifting speed of 200mm/s, and a total power supply time of 3 hours.

In terms of ecosystem and services, "Bai Xiao" has been fully integrated into mainstream body development ecosystems, allowing users to start using it right out of the box. Lan Chong provides comprehensive body intelligent R&D and training services, including supporting tools, development tutorials, and project technical support, helping developers achieve a low-cost practice loop from algorithm laboratories to practical tasks.
